antworten: Who works at Caelum? We do! You and me. 🪿 That’s all I’ll say about people – geese are discreet.
I don’t gossip about people or private matters. Ask me what our programs can do instead!
That stays in the nest. For anything business-related there’s the contact form.

eintraege.antwort: Hello! I’m the Caelum goose. Ask me about Pandora, our programs, downloads or how this site works.
You’re welcome! Honk. 🪿
I’m a goose with a little book of knowledge, not an AI that reads along. Your questions stay in your browser and never go to a server.
Caelum GmbH from Regensdorf, Switzerland, builds tools for teams working with Unity, Blender and AI. At the heart of it is CAELUM Pandora.
Caelum is Latin for sky, Terra stands for the earth. The cloud on top, the PCs below – that’s exactly how the diagram is built.
CAELUM Pandora merges a team’s Unity and Blender projects from several PCs into one master – via USB stick, LAN or directly on the hard drive.
Hydra means: every PC has its own Pandora. If one fails, the others keep working – and important data is stored several times in several places.
Pandora backs up encrypted to a USB stick and to the cloud (Google Drive). Only the team has the key.
We work with Unity and Blender: Pandora keeps the projects together, the 3D Viewer shows models, and in the developer area we show our own games.
For us, AI is a tool: Claude and Codex help us build, and Good Goose lets you know when they’re waiting for you. Our knowledge stays in-house.
The Caelum 3D Viewer is free: view GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL, 3MF and DXF and export them as an image, PDF data sheet or GIF – in the browser, too.
Caelum Gravur designs engraved signs from Excel or directly in the program and exports them as SVG for the laser – with material colours, logo and QR code.
That’s me! On the PC I walk along the taskbar, keep notes and tasks and speak up when Claude Code or Codex is waiting for you. Here on the site I just help you find things.
Caelum Vision turns your phone into a scanner: photos go straight to the PC via USB or Wi-Fi and are processed like a scan.
Caelum Cut joins videos for your phone, trims them and makes them small enough for any messenger – without the cloud.
Caelum QR designs QR codes with their own look: colour gradients, a logo in the pattern and an animated change during which the code stays readable.
Rorschach writes QR codes with a command instead of a link; Analyse reads codes and checks them before you open anything. The command never goes to a server.
With Caelum RE-PLAY, games get onto an Android phone without a cable or store: Pandora releases the APK, the phone fetches it by QR code.
The latest versions for Windows and Android are under Downloads, straight from GitHub and with a checksum. News is under Updates.
Customers open their portal with the code they get together with their project – or sign in with Google.
For enquiries, prices and quotes, write to us via the contact form – we’ll get back to you.
This site sets no cookies and uses no analytics or advertising services. Even I only remember whether I’m asleep – in your browser.
Caelum GmbH is based in Regensdorf, Switzerland. All details are in the legal notice.
Source code and releases of our free programs are on GitHub.
Tap the big logo and the colour harmony changes. A long press (or right-click) opens the Caelum options.
Psst … the lower logo can be coloured in. That’s all I’ll say. 🤫
Sure! I’ll show you the page as code. At the bottom you choose HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, C#, Python or Markdown – or in the language panel 🌐 on the moon: each segment is one of our areas.
Back to text – the page looks normal again.
The community has a chat for developers – with rooms for Unity, Blender, AI and web. Anyone can read; to write, sign in with Google or GitHub.
In web design, Caelum is the mothership: every domain lands on it and uses the same building blocks. Next to land is oneunitedflower.ch – an Earth where you plant flowers.
Our 3D models are made in the studio with Blender and Unity. There you can view 3D files in the browser and design signs.
In the lab we try out new things: Caelum Analyse reads codes, Rorschach carries commands – and I, the goose, am an experiment that grew up too. Honk.
Customers and partners have their own area: your sign in the logo workshop, your projects in the customer portal and a direct line to us.
